notes.title: WESTERN CITY DLC IS RELEASED
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814680/All_Hit_All_Her_Western_City/][b]ALL HIT ALL HER: WESTERN CITY[/b][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814680/All_Hit_All_Her_Western_City/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40444846/df573c9becc475de60284c5580736ba28e3c0439.png[/img][/url]

With this new dlc you will defend your city against the bandits invading your city in the wild west lands.
Added with the new dlc:
[olist]
[1] New Level Maps
[2] New Weapons
[3] New Enemys
[4] New Atmosphere
[/olist]
